note: Read RFC 9687 Section 4.3's whole restart sentence, including its zero-value exceptions, and every tagged function: SendRestartsTheSendHoldTimer, SilenceDoesNotRestartTheSendHoldTimer, EveryWriterRestartsTheSendHoldTimer, RemainingWritersRestartSendHold, EmissionRestartsExactSendHoldDeadline and SuppressedAttemptsDoNotRestartSendHold. Real RawMessage, generic KEEPALIVE, UPDATE/withdraw/raw-body, SendAnnounce, held writes, raw/parsed forward batches and dirty flush rails are exercised with nonzero negotiated hold; sending at 0.6 SendHoldTime retains Established and an armed timer past the old deadline. Exact-emission tests additionally compare wire frames and exact restarted deadline, including bufio direct writes, refresh/BoRR/EoRR, buffering without emission, and empty flush not reusing old emission. Policy suppression, duplicates, stale batches, empty operations and PATHS-LIMIT write no extra bytes, leave the exact deadline fixed and reach actual expiry. The silence unit now requires the exact ErrSendHoldTimerExpired sentinel, not just any completed Run. flushWrites consumes writePending and resets only after successful emission/flush; resetSendHoldTimer and sendHoldTimerCheck move/recheck the deadline. The zero negotiated HoldTime case is separately proven by the tagged -9 pair; effective zero SendHoldTime is unreachable because sendHoldDuration supplies a positive auto minimum. No proof loss from the sentinel addition. Source audit only; no native mutation result claimed.
